{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CeLgMqKBySF7ZsC2jhpTB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012FE5NbKMgUjDvZDfMmWU5C","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-uk8cqcbq/project/parts/valve_knob.py","content":"from nurb import *\n\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = cylinder(d=knob_diameter, h=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = cylinder(d=bore_diameter, h=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = box(notch_width, notch_height, bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = translate(notch, [0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5])\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = translate(bore, [0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth])\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 5\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        lobe = box(lobe_length, lobe_width, lobe_height)\n        lobe = translate(lobe, [knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2])\n        lobe = rotate(lobe, [0, 0, angle])\n        knob = knob | lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, 1)\n\n    return knob\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":293,"cache_read_input_tokens":40438,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":293},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"db04cdba-83dc-40ec-8ed8-d7ea39005733","uuid":"8d4f1529-05db-41b6-83e8-db851299b40d","timestamp":"2026-08-24T01:08:39.134Z","request_id":"req_011CeLgMpECYLsGuFwrHM8ZW"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"db04cdba-83dc-40ec-8ed8-d7ea39005733","uuid":"65adf698-023d-4266-905c-7031c5387be7","timestamp":"2026-08-24T01:09:39.574Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-uk8cqcbq/project/parts/valve_knob.py","oldString":"from nurb import *\n\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):","newString":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = cylinder(d=knob_diameter, h=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = cylinder(d=bore_diameter, h=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = box(notch_width, notch_height, bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = translate(notch, [0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5])\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = translate(bore, [0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth])\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 5\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        lobe = box(lobe_length, lobe_width, lobe_height)\n        lobe = translate(lobe, [knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2])\n        lobe = rotate(lobe, [0, 0, angle])\n        knob = knob | lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, 1)\n\n    return knob\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":5,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":[" from nurb import *"," ","+@part"," def valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):","     \"\"\"","     Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = cylinder(d=knob_diameter, h=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = cylinder(d=bore_diameter, h=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = box(notch_width, notch_height, bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = translate(notch, [0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5])\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = translate(bore, [0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth])\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 5\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        lobe = box(lobe_length, lobe_width, lobe_height)\n        lobe = translate(lobe, [knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2])\n        lobe = rotate(lobe, [0, 0, angle])\n        knob = knob | lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, 1)\n\n    return knob","new_string":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"db04cdba-83dc-40ec-8ed8-d7ea39005733","uuid":"f4a2d763-aed8-4233-abc0-55cce7c4ccd5","timestamp":"2026-08-24T01:11:10.342Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-uk8cqcbq/project/parts/valve_knob.py","oldString":"    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, 1)\n\n    return knob","newString":"    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, knob.edges(), 1)\n\n    return knob","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = Cylinder(radius=knob_diameter/2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_radius, height=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = Box(length=notch_width, width=notch_height, height=bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = notch.moved(Location((0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5)))\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = bore.moved(Location((0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth)))\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 5\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        lobe = Box(length=lobe_length, width=lobe_width, height=lobe_height)\n        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, 1)\n\n    return knob\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":61,"oldLines":6,"newStart":61,"newLines":6,"lines":["         knob = knob + lobe"," ","     # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance","-    knob = polish(knob, 1)","+    knob = polish(knob, knob.edges(), 1)"," ","     return knob"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

lobe_length/2, 0, lobe_height/2)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = Cylinder(radius=knob_diameter/2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_radius, height=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = Box(length=notch_width, width=notch_height, height=bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = notch.moved(Location((0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5)))\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = bore.moved(Location((0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth)))\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 5\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        lobe = Box(length=lobe_length, width=lobe_width, height=lobe_height)\n        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, knob.edges(), 1)\n\n    return knob\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":14,"newStart":49,"newLines":16,"lines":["     # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping","     # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder","     lobe_height = knob_height / 2","-    lobe_length = 5","+    lobe_length = 8  # extends from cylinder surface outward","     lobe_width = 5","-    lobe_offset = 4.2  # extends 4.2mm beyond base radius","+    lobe_reach = 4.2  # total reach beyond base radius"," ","     for i in range(2):","         angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart","+        # Position lobe so it overlaps with and extends beyond the cylinder","         lobe = Box(length=lobe_length, width=lobe_width, height=lobe_height)","-        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_offset, 0, lobe_height/2)))","+        # Center the lobe at a position that overlaps the cylinder","+        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_reach - lobe_length/2, 0, 0)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(shaft_diameter=8.0, shaft_across_flat=6.5):\n    \"\"\"\n    Replacement knob for a D-shaft valve handle.\n\n    The knob bore-up as it prints: bore opens straight up on the part's vertical\n    centerline, with the stem's flat facing +X. In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = Cylinder(radius=knob_diameter/2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_radius, height=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = Box(length=notch_width, width=notch_height, height=bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = notch.moved(Location((0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5)))\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = bore.moved(Location((0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth)))\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    # At mid-height, this creates a shape wider than the base cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height / 2\n    lobe_length = 8  # extends from cylinder surface outward\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_reach = 4.2  # total reach beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        # Position lobe so it overlaps with and extends beyond the cylinder\n        lobe = Box(length=lobe_length, width=lobe_width, height=lobe_height)\n        # Center the lobe at a position that overlaps the cylinder\n        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_reach - lobe_length/2, 0, lobe_height/2)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, knob.edges(), 1)\n\n    return knob\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":8,"newStart":47,"newLines":7,"lines":["     knob = body - In use the knob flips over onto\n    the stem.\n\n    shaft_diameter: D-shaft outer diameter (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: D-shaft flat-to-flat width (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Dimensions optimized for volume budget and functionality\n    knob_height = 20\n    knob_diameter = 28\n\n    # Main cylindrical body\n    body = Cylinder(radius=knob_diameter/2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # D-shaped bore for the valve stem\n    bore_depth = 12.5  # stem stands 12mm proud, plus margin\n\n    # Bore sized to accept 0.3mm-grown stem (diameter + 0.6mm tolerance)\n    # with minimal clearance for the jam/torque tests\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.65\n    bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2\n\n    # Create bore: cylinder with flat cutout for D-shape\n    bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_radius, height=bore_depth)\n\n    # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore\n    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile\n    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1\n    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5\n    notch = Box(length=notch_width, width=notch_height, height=bore_depth + 1)\n    notch = notch.moved(Location((0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5)))\n\n    bore = bore - notch\n\n    # Position bore at top center of knob\n    bore = bore.moved(Location((0, 0, knob_height - bore_depth)))\n\n    # Create knob with bore\n    knob = body - bore\n\n    # Add grip features: 2 diametrically opposite lobes for gripping\n    lobe_height = knob_height  # full height to ensure solid connection\n    lobe_length = 8  # extends from cylinder surface outward\n    lobe_width = 5\n    lobe_reach = 4.2  # total reach beyond base radius\n\n    for i in range(2):\n        angle = i * 180  # 180 degrees apart\n        # Position lobe so it overlaps with and extends beyond the cylinder\n        lobe = Box(length=lobe_length, width=lobe_width, height=lobe_height)\n        # Center the lobe at a position that overlaps the cylinder\n        lobe = lobe.moved(Location((knob_diameter/2 + lobe_reach - lobe_length/2, 0, 0)))\n        lobe = lobe.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)\n        knob = knob + lobe\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges for a finished appearance\n    knob = polish(knob, knob.edges(), 1)\n\n    return knob\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":32,"oldLines":11,"newStart":32,"newLines":11,"lines":["     bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_radius, height=bore_depth)"," ","     # Rectangular notch for the flat side of the D-bore","-    # This removes the flat-facing side, creating the D-profile","-    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1","-    notch_height = bore_radius + 0.5","-    notch = Box(length=notch_width, width=notch_height, height=bore_depth + 1)","-    notch = notch.moved(Location((0, -(bore_radius + notch_height/2), -0.5)))","+    # The stem's flat faces +X, so the bore's flat (notch) faces -X","+    notch_length = bore_radius + 1  # depth of the notch","+    notch_width = bore_diameter + 1  # width to cut through the bore","+    notch = Box(length=notch_length, width=notch_width, height=bore_depth + 1)","+    notch = notch.moved(Location((-(bore_radius + notch_length/2), 0, -0.5)))"," ","     bore = bore -
